text: How do we know whether our working environment is truly ergonomic?
Office workers spend hours in front of computers, often maintaining static postures that may lead to musculoskeletal discomfort and psychological strain.
Yet, ergonomic risks are not always visible at first glance.
Poor working posture, prolonged static activities, and suboptimal workstation design can contribute to physical ergonomic risks.
At the same time, psychological factors, including perceived stress, may further influence workers' overall well-being.
These interconnected dimensions highlight the need for a more comprehensive approach to ergonomic risk assessment.
Conventional ergonomic assessments often evaluate physical posture and psychological conditions separately.
Physical assessments may rely on manual observation, while psychological conditions are measured through self-report questionnaires.
When these assessments are not integrated, the interaction between physical and psychological risks may be overlooked.
We developed ERGO-AI DESK, an AI-assisted multidomain ergonomic assessment system for computer users.

It combines YOLOv11-based computer vision to assess body posture and workstation characteristics with brief self-report questionnaires covering ergonomic and psychosocial factors, including lighting, break habits, and perceived psychological strain.
By integrating both assessments, the system generates ergonomic risk scores and targeted workplace improvement recommendations.
Users capture their working posture using a camera, while YOLOv11 analyzes body keypoints and ergonomic indicators.
They then complete a brief questionnaire on workstation conditions, work habits, and psychological strain.
Both results are integrated into a dashboard displaying ergonomic risk scores and targeted improvement recommendations.
ERGO-AI DESK aims to provide accessible and comprehensive ergonomic screening, with ongoing development and expert validation to improve assessment accuracy and support healthier, safer workplaces.
ERGO-AI DESK integrates AI-based posture analysis and psychosocial assessment for multidomain ergonomic risk evaluation.
Smarter assessment, healthier workplaces. Thank you.
